stemBlocks: A light spring has an uncompressed length of $0.10\ \text{m}$. When an object of mass $0.5\ \text{kg}$ rests in equilibrium on top of the spring, the length of the spring reduces to $0.08\ \text{m}$ as shown.
What is the energy stored in the spring due to the compression? (gravitational field strength = $10\ \text{N}\,\text{kg}^{-1}$; the spring obeys Hooke's law)
